svg.title: SharePoint file intake through Connector Namespace Poll delivery into private Cosmos DB
svg.desc: SharePoint file metadata is queued in a public Connector Namespace. A VNet-integrated Azure Function authenticates with managed identity and pulls events outbound, then writes documents to Cosmos DB over a private endpoint. Public inbound access is disabled on the Function and Cosmos DB. Identity-protected host and deployment storage remains public.
svg.text: SharePoint file intake with outbound Poll delivery
Typed connector payloads, managed identity, and private Cosmos DB writes
Private endpoints + DNS; public Function/Cosmos access disabled
No inbound callback URL or public dev tunnel. Poll processing uses outbound authenticated requests.
